stem: How does Whitman demonstrate the American way of life in the mid-1800s in this poem?

options.label: A
options.text: He explains the civic responsibilities that all citizens have.

options.label: B
options.text: He describes the individualism that citizens highly valued.

options.label: C
options.text: He provides an example of the ideas of the temperance movement.

options.label: D
options.text: He puts into words the ideals shown in the Hudson River School of art.

visual_elements: I CELEBRATE myself, and sing myself, And what I assume you shall assume, For every atom belonging to me as good belongs to you.  —Walt Whitman, “Song of Myself,” 1855
